info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Statements Retrieval API
info.description: The Financial Statements Retrieval API provides access to detailed financial statements for business accounts. This endpoint allows users to fetch historical and current financial data, facilitating financial analysis and reporting. Typical consumers include financial analysts, accountants, and business management teams who need to make informed decisions based on the latest financial information. By utilizing this API, organizations can automate data retrieval processes and enhance their financial planning and strategy.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the financial statements of the organization, providing an overview of the financial performance and position. Use this to access data necessary for financial analysis and reporting.

requestBody.description: This request body triggers the retrieval of financial statements, allowing users to specify necessary parameters for the operation.

200.description: The request was successful, and financial statements data is returned.

GetFinancialStatementsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to financial statements.

items.description: A list of financial statement entries pertaining to various legal entities.

sort.description: Indicates the sort order applied to the results.

GetFinancialStatementsResponse_200.description: Response schema for retrieving financial statements, including pagination and metadata information.

legalEntityId.description: Unique identifier for the legal entity.

ledgerId.description: Identifier for the ledger associated with this financial statement entry.

accountingPeriod.description: The accounting period to which this entry belongs.

postingDate.description: The date this entry was posted.

recordStatus.description: The status of the record (e.g., active, inactive).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when this entry was last updated.

FinancialStatementEntry.description: Represents a single entry in the financial statements for a legal entity.

value.description: The monetary value of the amount.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is denominated.

Amount.description: Defines the amount and its associated currency.

page.description: Current page number of the results.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page.

Pagination.description: Pagination details for the result set.

responseId.description: Unique identifier for the API response.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate related requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the request was processed.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the specific API endpoint being accessed. This helps in tracing the request throughout the system.

X-Runtime-App.description: Indicates the version of the runtime application processing the request. Useful for debugging and ensuring compatibility.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a bearer token, which is a JSON Web Token (JWT). The client must include this token in the Authorization header when making requests to secure the API.
